definitions.explanation: A collective term for seeds, bulbs, and young plants used for propagation in agriculture, horticulture, and forestry.

examples.japanese: {種苗|しゅびょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{種苗店|しゅびょうてん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧にぎわう。
examples.english: Seed shops become bustling when spring arrives.

examples.japanese: {新品種|しんひんしゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{種苗|しゅびょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{種苗法|しゅびょうほう}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{保護|ほご}→保護：03625_hogo⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Seeds and seedlings of new varieties are protected by the Plant Variety Protection and Seed Act.

notes:
Combines ⟦{種|しゅ}→種：28584_shu⟧ (seed) and {苗|びょう} (seedling). Used primarily in agriculture, gardening, and legal contexts. In everyday conversation, people more often say ⟦{種|たね}→種：02157_tane⟧ (seeds) or ⟦{苗|なえ}→苗：05489_nae⟧ (seedlings) separately.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {種苗店|しゅびょうてん}: seed and seedling shop
- {種苗法|しゅびょうほう}: Plant Variety Protection and Seed Act
- {種苗|しゅびょう}⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧: seed company
- {種苗|しゅびょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生産|せいさん}→生産：01444_seisan⟧: production of planting stock
- {種苗|しゅびょう}{交換会|こうかんかい}: seed exchange event

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{種|たね}→種：02157_tane⟧: seed — everyday word for individual seeds
- ⟦{苗|なえ}→苗：05489_nae⟧: seedling, young plant — everyday word for transplantable young plants
- ⟦{苗木|なえぎ}→苗木：15679_naegi⟧: sapling, nursery tree — specifically young trees for transplanting
